scenario: [LNLS.3.10] / [LSTR.11.4]: a `String` slot that declares `capacity N` may be an operand of a single-pattern ordering comparison with `linear_scan: false` -- it costs O(N) with N a compile-time constant. Companions `LNLS.3.10.json` and `LNLS.3.10_ordering.json` are the same operation without the capacity, refused with `DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_UNBOUNDED_STRING_OP`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.unbounded_string`'s `lstr_11_4_declares_capacity` arm, reached from `lnls_compare`'s single-binding arm.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Line scope logical:
    k: Int key
    text: String capacity 64 mutable

rule r:
    Line l where l.text < "m"
->
    log info "x"
